name: Islamic Society of Toronto - Masjid Darus Salaam
notes: Also known as Masjid Darus Salaam. The official site lists daily prayers and Islamic education programs.
visitorNotes: Check the official site or phone the office before you go. Prayer times, parking notes, and programs all change.
jumuahNote: The official site posts Jumu'ah times and prayer-time updates. Confirm the schedule before you go.
classSupportNote: The listed programs include an evening Quran class, Sunday madrasah, Hifz, Alim and Alima studies, and Islamic essential studies.
parkingNote: The official site warns about the private parking nearby. Read the current instructions before you park.

name: TARIC Islamic Centre
notes: A long-running Islamic center that posts its event schedule publicly and runs regular community programming.
visitorNotes: Check the official site or phone the center for current Jumu'ah times, events, and visitor support.
classSupportNote: Published event material lists family seminars, Ramadan activities, Eid events, community outreach, and youth and family programming.

name: MAC Masjid Toronto (Dundas)
notes: The Dundas location of MAC Masjid Toronto. A second location is on Adelaide Street East.
visitorNotes: Downtown gets busy around Jumu'ah, so give yourself extra time. Check current timings and which entrance to use before you go.
jumuahNote: Three Jumu'ah prayers (12:10, 1:10 and 2:10 PM in September 2026). Check the site for the current week.
womenSpaceNote: The sisters' prayer area is reached by a stairwell marked Sister's Entrance.
newMuslimSupportNote: The After the Shahadah class meets here on the 2nd and 4th Sunday afternoons. The official page gives two different start times, so email convertconnect@masjidtoronto.com to confirm. A Convert Connect Group meets on the 1st and 3rd Sunday after Dhuhr, and you can ask for someone to meet you on your first visit.
accessibilityNote: There is an elevator behind the brothers' prayer area.
classSupportNote: The programs page also lists Islamic Education in Sign Language on the 2nd and 4th Sunday.

name: Islamic Foundation of Toronto
notes: A large facility with a prayer hall, classes, and public programming.
visitorNotes: Contact the office before you attend to confirm programs, class registration, and what visitor support is available.
classSupportNote: Published listings show education programs including Hifz and Sunday school, plus community services.

name: Khalid Bin Al-Walid Mosque
notes: An Etobicoke mosque that keeps its contact details and programming updates current on its own site.
visitorNotes: Phone the office or check the official site before you go. Older listings elsewhere still carry an out-of-date address.
jumuahNote: Confirm current Jumu'ah and prayer times directly with the masjid.

name: Imdadul Islamic Centre
notes: A community mosque running worship, family, youth, volunteer, and outreach programming.
visitorNotes: The official site asks visitors to get in touch with the masjid for questions, support, or ways to help out.
jumuahNote: The official site lists two Jumu'ah prayers. Confirm the current times before you go.
classSupportNote: Published descriptions mention prayer services, community outreach, volunteer openings, and family programming.
parkingNote: Arrive early for Jumu'ah, and ask the masjid where to park.

name: Masjid El Noor
notes: An established Toronto masjid with daily prayer, classes, and community services.
visitorNotes: The official site posts Jumu'ah, parking, and program updates. Check the current details before you visit.
womenSpaceNote: The about page describes separate prayer halls for brothers and sisters.
accessibilityNote: The about page mentions ramps and designated parking spaces.
jumuahNote: The official site lists one Jumu'ah prayer, with an English lecture before the Arabic khutbah. Confirm the current times.
classSupportNote: Listed programs include Evening Maktaab and Quran classes.
parkingNote: The official site posts parking guidance for Jumu'ah and asks visitors not to block hydrants, crosswalks, or driveways.

name: Islamic Institute of Toronto
notes: An educational institute and community center. Contact details and directions are on its own site.
visitorNotes: Use the official contact page for directions, class information, and any visitor questions.
classSupportNote: The official site describes IIT as a non-profit educational institute and posts program and newsletter updates.
newMuslimSupportNote: The New Muslim Corner is a free course of 25 recorded lessons. The course page also mentions a Friday 7:00 PM class for new Muslims, but it is not confirmed that it still runs live, so ask the office.

name: Jami Mosque Toronto | ISNA Canada
notes: A historic Toronto mosque, now listed under ISNA Canada.
visitorNotes: Check hours, Jumu'ah times, and event access with ISNA Canada before you go.

name: Abu Huraira Center
notes: A large GTA community center. Prayer, classes, counseling, youth work, and new Muslim support all run out of the same building.
visitorNotes: The official site lists programs and contact information. Confirm visitor support and class registration before you attend.
newMuslimSupportNote: The official site lists New Muslim support among its services.
classSupportNote: Listed programs include Quran classes, weekend school, Hifdh, youth activities, and regular halaqas.

name: Islamic Centre of Canada (ISNA)
notes: ISNA Canada's headquarters, and a community center in its own right, with a musallah, youth space, education rooms, and event space.
visitorNotes: Check prayer times, classes, event access, and visitor support with ISNA Canada before you go.
classSupportNote: The official page describes an education center, a youth hub, a musallah, and bookable community spaces.
newMuslimSupportNote: ISNA Canada's New Muslims and Convert Care offers weekly classes, monthly socials, and a Being Muslim box with a Quran translation, books and a prayer rug. The class day, time and place are not published, so call the office or use the contact form.

name: Al-Farooq Al-Azam Mosque (Ottawa South Mosque)
notes: Area: Old Ottawa South. Also known as Jamia Masjid Farooq-e-Azam; Masjid Farooq Azam.
womenSpaceNote: "Weekly Tajweed ul Qur'an Session (for sisters)" Saturdays 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM; prayer-space layout not described.
jumuahNote: First session 2:00 PM, second session 2:45 PM (homepage).

name: Bukhari Community Centre & Masjid
notes: Area: Overbrook / St. Laurent Blvd. Also known as Bukhari Centre; Bukhari Masjid & Community Centre.
womenSpaceNote: Friday page: "2nd Jumu'ah: 2pm (Open to brothers & sisters)"; the first Jumu'ah is brothers only. A separate women's area is not described.
accessibilityNote: About page mentions new front and back doors "enhancing both security and accessibility"; no specific accessibility features stated.
jumuahNote: "1st Jumu'ah: 1pm (Open to brothers) 2nd Jumu'ah: 2pm (Open to brothers & sisters)".

name: Centretown Mosque
notes: Area: Centretown. The site says the community is still working to secure a permanent space at 397 Kent Street, so confirm the location before you go.
womenSpaceNote: A 'Sisters' Arabic Class' (Saturdays 12:00 PM, adult sisters) is listed; prayer-space layout not described.
jumuahNote: "Join our community every Friday for the Khutbah and congregational prayer at 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM.".
newMuslimSupportNote: The site lists New Muslim Seminars, "a welcoming space to learn the foundational principles of Islam". No schedule is given.

name: Darul Arqum (Riverside South Muslim Community Association)
notes: Area: Riverside South. Also known as Darul Arqum Riverside South.
jumuahNote: "Jumu'ah 1:30 PM & 2:30 PM" (homepage); prayer times page: "1st Khutbah 1:30 PM & 2nd Khutbah 2:30 PM".
parkingNote: Contact page: "Parking is on the premises. Overnight parking needs authorisation from the board first.".

name: Darul Uloom Ottawa
notes: Area: Orleans. Also known as Darul-Uloom Mosque.
jumuahNote: Homepage lists off-site Jumu'ah: "Navan 1:15 Juma@Aqsa Centre" and "Blackburn 1:15 Juma@Quba Centre". About page says the centre facilitates daily prayers including the Friday sermon.

name: East Ottawa Masjid and Community Center (EOMCC)
notes: Area: Vanier / Overbrook area.
jumuahNote: Homepage: "Jumma: 1st: 1:15 PM | 2nd: 2:15 PM".

name: Islam Care Centre
jumuahNote: Homepage: Jumu'ah "12:30 & 1:15PM" at Knox Presbyterian Church basement, 120 Lisgar St, Ottawa, ON K2P 2L7 (off-site location).
newMuslimSupportNote: Convert Care is a free weekly class on the basics of Islam, every Wednesday at 6:00 pm at the centre.

name: Jami Omar
notes: Area: Bells Corners / Nepean. Also known as Masjid Jami Omar; JMOC.
jumuahNote: Homepage: "Jumuah prayer 12pm-3pm".
parkingNote: Homepage: park only in approved areas; parking available at D.A. Moodie School.

name: Kanata Muslim Association
notes: Area: Kanata. Also known as KMA.
jumuahNote: "3 Fri. Prayers: 1 pm / 2.15 pm / 3.45 pm" (third prayer time adjusts).

name: MAC Barrhaven Islamic Centre
notes: Area: Barrhaven. Also known as BIC.
jumuahNote: "1st Khotbah: 1:00 PM" and "2nd Khotbah: 2:30 PM".

name: MAC Islamic Centre (Muslim Association of Canada, Ottawa Chapter)
notes: Area: Nepean / Grenon Ave. Also known as MAC Grenon; located in the Abraar School building.

name: MAC Qurtuba Islamic Centre (MAC QIC)
notes: Area: Nepean / Merivale. Also known as MAC Qurtuba; QIC.

name: Markaz At-Tawheed
notes: Area: Bayshore / Dumaurier. Also known as Markaz At-Tawheed Ottawa.
visitorNotes: Homepage notes some lectures are "in Arabic, with pauses for English translation"; other content is in English.
womenSpaceNote: Ramadan notice: "Jumu'ah khutbah and Salah is for brothers only (space constraint)"; "Maximum capacity: 12 sisters nightly" for Isha and Tarawih.
jumuahNote: Homepage shows "Khutbah starts at 12:30 p.m" in one block and "Khutbah begins: 1:15 p.m." in a Ramadan update; brothers only.

name: Masjid Bilal (Islamic Society of Cumberland)
notes: Area: Orleans. Also known as Bilal Masjid; Islamic Society of Cumberland.
visitorNotes: Homepage labels the pre-khutbah talk "Speech (English Talk)".
womenSpaceNote: Mosque Visit page: "men and women pray in separate prayer halls".
jumuahNote: Jumu'ah 1: English talk 12:45 pm, khutbah 1:15 pm; Jumu'ah 2: no talk, khutbah 2:20 pm; Jumu'ah 3: English talk 3:00 pm, khutbah 3:10 pm.

name: Masjid ar-Rahmah (Assunnah Muslims Association)
notes: Area: Gloucester / South Keys. Also known as Mosque of Mercy; AMA; AMA Community Centre.
visitorNotes: Confirmed English for the converts Q&A session ('Language : English only'); site in English with an Arabic site link.
newMuslimSupportNote: The Revert Corner page has free resources for new Muslims, and Muslim's Basics is a recorded 37-episode English course. The convert events on the site date from 2021 and 2022, so ask what runs now.

name: Ottawa Muslim Association (Ottawa Mosque)
notes: Also known as Ottawa Main Mosque; OMA.
womenSpaceNote: FAQ: "We provide a designated prayer area for women, as well as family-friendly spaces".
jumuahNote: FAQ says the mosque offers Friday (Jumu'ah) prayers; times not published on its website.

name: Ottawa Uyghur Centre (OUC)
notes: Area: Orleans.
jumuahNote: Services page: "Join us for Jumu'ah khutbahs"; times not stated.

name: Richmond Islamic Community Ottawa (RICO)
notes: Area: Richmond. Also known as RICO.
womenSpaceNote: Programs page lists a Qur'an halaqa for teen and adult sisters; prayer space for women not stated.
jumuahNote: Homepage: "Jumu'ah Fridays Only 1:15 PM Jumu'ah 1 2:30 PM Jumu'ah 2". Services: "We offer Isha prayers in winter, Asr, Magrib and Isha in Summer and Friday Jumu'ah prayers.".

name: Siraj Institute (Alshareef Islamic Centre)
notes: Area: Nepean.

name: South Nepean Muslim Community (SNMC)
notes: Area: Nepean / Barrhaven. Also known as SNMC Center & Masjid.
womenSpaceNote: Sisters' programs (halaqa and others) with a sisters' programming email sisters@snmc.ca; prayer-space layout not described.
newMuslimSupportNote: The Reverts page invites you to get in touch for information, questions, a shahada certificate or a tour. No class or mentor program is described.

name: Stittsville Muslim Association (SMA)
notes: Area: Stittsville. The official site shows two postal codes (K2S 1E3 and K2S 0T9). Check before you go.
jumuahNote: Homepage: 1:15 PM, 2:15 PM, 3:45 PM.

name: The Islamic Society of Gloucester
notes: Area: Gloucester. Also known as ISG Masjid.
jumuahNote: Homepage: "Friday Prayer Times Khutbah 1.30 PM - Iqama 2:00 PM".
parkingNote: Eid notice on homepage: "Church parking is not available; instead, you can park at Costco Parking lot & Rona 1880 innes Road"; "No parking allowed directly in front of the mosque entrance". Regular-day parking not stated.

name: The Ottawa Islamic Centre & Assalam Mosque
notes: Area: Ottawa South / St. Laurent Blvd. Also known as Assalam Mosque; Masjid Assalam.
womenSpaceNote: Homepage: "We offer one of the largest prayer halls in Ottawa for men and women for daily salah & Jumuah.".
